description: This file defines functions and data structures related to port validation and management within the Chromium project, including lists of restricted ports, allowed ports, and functions to check port validity and permissions.

classes.name: ScopedPortException
classes.description: A RAII class that temporarily allows a specific port by adding it to the explicitly allowed ports list upon construction and removing it upon destruction.

classes.name: ScopedAllowablePortForTesting
classes.description: A testing utility class that sets a scoped allowable port for testing purposes.

methods.name: ScopedPortException
methods.description: Constructor that adds a port to the explicitly allowed ports list.

methods.name: ~ScopedPortException
methods.description: Destructor that removes the port from the explicitly allowed ports list.

methods.name: IsPortValid
methods.description: Checks if a port number is within the valid range (0 to 65535).

methods.name: IsWellKnownPort
methods.description: Checks if a port is a well-known port (less than 1024).

methods.name: IsPortAllowedForScheme
methods.description: Determines if a port is allowed for a given URL scheme based on restrictions and explicit allowances.

methods.name: GetCountOfExplicitlyAllowedPorts
methods.description: Returns the number of ports explicitly allowed.

methods.name: SetExplicitlyAllowedPorts
methods.description: Sets the list of explicitly allowed ports from a span of port numbers.

methods.name: IsAllowablePort
methods.description: Checks if a port is allowable, considering scoped and predefined allowable ports.

methods.name: ScopedAllowablePortForTesting
methods.description: Sets a scoped allowable port for testing; constructor sets the port, destructor resets it.
